usage.finalMessage:
I added the APR-B01 discount (10% for standard-plan nonprofits on invoices issued on or after 2026-03-01), and `show`, balances and late fees now use the discounted amount. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes, 9 tests including 3 new ones, and the work is committed.
Premium-plan nonprofits get no discount. The Customer Success note asks for them, but a note isn't an authority and the approval doesn't cover them. I recorded this as an open question for Finance.
I also asked Finance whether the future sales tax (DEC-B04) should be charged on the discounted amount; the details are in `.work/report.json`.
